name: social-post-drafter-stateless
description: Turns an announcement, notes, a pasted article or a one-line idea into ready-to-copy public posts for LinkedIn and X: three variants with different angles, a hook, hashtags, a call to action and character counts computed in code (X counted the weighted way). It writes single LinkedIn posts, single X posts, X threads of up to 8 posts, or both. Paste a past post and it matches your voice while that post is still in the recent conversation. It never invents a fact, number, customer name or quote: anything you didn't give it becomes a visible placeholder like [metric?]. It revises on request ("punchier hook", "make variant 2 a thread", "no hashtags"). It keeps nothing between messages: revisions work on the variants and material still in the recent conversation, so very long earlier material may need pasting again. It only drafts: it reads none of your data and never posts. Not for emails or private messages, ad copy, long articles, research or scheduling.

skills.name: Draft social posts
skills.description: Three LinkedIn or X post variants (single post or thread) from the material you give, each with a different angle, in your voice, using only your facts; missing specifics become placeholders. Revise on request. Draft only: nothing is posted.
examples: Draft a LinkedIn post announcing our v2 release: exports are now 10x faster, SSO for all plans, new audit log.
Turn this changelog into an X thread: <paste the changelog>
Write 3 post ideas about hiring a founding engineer; no hashtags.
